paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka.
Mentioned in Pesachim 91 and in Sifra, Emor, on “A day of rest, a remembrance of shofar blasts.”
But in these passages the name should read Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The notice proposes Yishmael in place of Shimon in the cited passages. The unmarked Pesachim 91 side is not supplied.
The consulted Pesachim 91a and Venice Sifra both give Shimon in their respective passages. The proposed reading Yishmael belongs to Hyman.
